informal_statement: For every real \(\lambda\) and \(R>0\), \(A_{\mathrm{C}}\) has derivative \(2R Q_{\mathrm{C}}(R)\) at \(R\).
reason: `CMVBallCase.lean:572-609`: Lean requires only \(R>0\) and permits all real \(\lambda\). The complementary-angle identity and \(\cos (b)=R \sin (b)\) cancel the overlap derivatives, yielding \(R\cdot (2Q_{\mathrm{C}})\), as translated.
